bag_wtp_plan_run = {

	# **Nothing is re-read from CMM here any more.** The caps, the rights tick and
	# «на конец» were settings on the mod page and had to be copied into globals
	# at the top of every run; they are controls in the plan's own window now and
	# write their globals themselves.

	bag_wtp_plan_score = yes

	}

	bag_wtp_plan_allocate = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_rank = yes

	# empty, which is the true answer: nothing has been edited yet, and everything
	# after this is measured against what the formula produced.
	bag_wtp_edit_save = yes
	cmf_log = { action = bag_wtp_log_plan }
}

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn23 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn24 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn25 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn26 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn27 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn28 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn29 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn30 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn31 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn32 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn33 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn34 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn35 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn36 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn37 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn38 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn39 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn40 value = 0 }

	# Every candidate made ready. **Every counter a `limit` reads has to exist
	# before the first round**: a comparison against a variable that is not there
	# is the failure that logs nothing.
	#
	# `_plan_seen` marks the province through its first candidate, so
	# `_plan_prov_locs` is one location per province -- what the row ordering
	# walks, and the only thing the plan still asks a province.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prank value = 9999 }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_goods
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_builds
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_touched target = this }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_town_row value = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rooms add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_urban }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prooms_t add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_urban }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_towns add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_town_row
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rooms add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_rural }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prooms_r add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_rural }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_seen } }
			province_definition = {
				every_location_in_province_definition = {
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_seen value = 1 }
				}
			}
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provn add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# clay: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng1` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_1 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest1 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm1 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm1 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng1 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt1 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr1 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p1 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest1
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest1 value = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr1 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest1
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest1 value = var:bag_wtp_pr1 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:clay }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo1 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot1 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor1 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng1 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo2 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot2 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor2 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng2 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# cotton: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng3` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_3 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm3 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm3 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm3 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm3 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest3 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm3 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm3 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng3 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt3 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr3 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p3 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest3
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest3 value = var:bag_wtp_p3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr3 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest3
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest3 value = var:bag_wtp_pr3 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:cotton }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo3 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot3 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor3 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng3 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng5 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt5 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr5 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p5 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest5
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest5 value = var:bag_wtp_p5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr5 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest5
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest5 value = var:bag_wtp_pr5 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:fiber_crops }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo5 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot5 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor5 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng5 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# fish: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng6` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_6 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm6 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm6 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm6 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm6 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm6 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng6 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt6 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr6 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo6 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot6 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor6 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest6 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm6 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm6 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng6 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt6 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr6 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p6 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest6
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest6 value = var:bag_wtp_p6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr6 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest6
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest6 value = var:bag_wtp_pr6 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:fish }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo6 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot6 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor6 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng6 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng8 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt8 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr8 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo8 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot8 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor8 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest8 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm8 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm8 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng8 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt8 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr8 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p8 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest8
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest8 value = var:bag_wtp_p8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr8 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest8
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest8 value = var:bag_wtp_pr8 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:horses }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo8 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot8 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor8 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng8 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# incense: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng9` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_9 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p9 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm9 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr9 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm9 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm9 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p9 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm9 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm9 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr9 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm9 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p9 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm9 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr9 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm9 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm9 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p9 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm9 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm9 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr9 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm9 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng9 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt9 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr9 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo9 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot9 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor9 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest9 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm9 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm9 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng9 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt9 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr9 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {

				var:bag_wtp_p9 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest9
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest9 value = var:bag_wtp_p9 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr9 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest9
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest9 value = var:bag_wtp_pr9 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:incense }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo9 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую

			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm11 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p11 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm11 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm11 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr11 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm11 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p11 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm11 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr11 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm11 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm11 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p11 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm11 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm11 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr11 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm11 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng11 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt11 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr11 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo11 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot11 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor11 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest11 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm11 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm11 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng11 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt11 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr11 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p11 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest11
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest11 value = var:bag_wtp_p11 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr11 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest11
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest11 value = var:bag_wtp_pr11 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:ivory }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo11 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot11 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor11 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng11 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# livestock: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng12` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_12 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p12 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm12 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr12 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm12 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm12 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p12 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm12 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm12 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr12 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm12 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p12 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm12 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr12 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm12 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm12 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p12 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm12 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm12 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr12 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm12 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и

	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng12 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt12 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr12 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo12 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot12 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor12 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest12 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is

					var:bag_wtp_pm12 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm12 > 0

			}
		}

# medicaments: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng14` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_14 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm14 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm14 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm14 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm14 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm14 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng14 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt14 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr14 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo14 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot14 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor14 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest14 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm14 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm14 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng14 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt14 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr14 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p14 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest14
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest14 value = var:bag_wtp_p14 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr14 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest14
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest14 value = var:bag_wtp_pr14 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:medicaments }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo14 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot14 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor14 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng14 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor16 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest16 value = 0 }

		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.

				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p16 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest16
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest16 value = var:bag_wtp_p16 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr16 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest16
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest16 value = var:bag_wtp_pr16 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:saltpeter }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo16 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot16 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor16 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng16 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# sand: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng17` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_17 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p17 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm17 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr17 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm17 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm17 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p17 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm17 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm17 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr17 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm17 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p17 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm17 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr17 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm17 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm17 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p17 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm17 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm17 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr17 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm17 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng17 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt17 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr17 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo17 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot17 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor17 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest17 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm17 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm17 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng17 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt17 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr17 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p17 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest17
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest17 value = var:bag_wtp_p17 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr17 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest17
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest17 value = var:bag_wtp_pr17 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:sand }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo17 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot17 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor17 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng17 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm19 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm19 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng19 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt19 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr19 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p19 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest19
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest19 value = var:bag_wtp_p19 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr19 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest19
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest19 value = var:bag_wtp_pr19 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:silver }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo19 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot19 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor19 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng19 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# stone: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng20` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_20 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p20 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm20 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr20 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm20 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p20 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm20 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm20 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr20 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm20 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p20 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm20 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr20 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm20 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p20 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm20 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm20 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr20 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm20 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng20 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt20 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr20 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo20 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot20 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor20 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest20 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm20 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm20 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng20 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt20 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr20 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p20 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest20
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest20 value = var:bag_wtp_p20 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr20 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest20
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest20 value = var:bag_wtp_pr20 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:stone }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo20 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot20 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor20 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng20 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}
