		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng22 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt22 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr22 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo22 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot22 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor22 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest22 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm22 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm22 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng22 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt22 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr22 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p22 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest22
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest22 value = var:bag_wtp_p22 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr22 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest22
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest22 value = var:bag_wtp_pr22 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:tobacco }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo22 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot22 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor22 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng22 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# wild_game: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng23` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_23 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm23 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm23 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm23 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm23 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm23 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng23 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt23 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr23 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo23 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot23 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor23 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest23 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm23 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm23 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng23 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt23 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr23 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p23 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest23
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest23 value = var:bag_wtp_p23 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr23 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest23
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest23 value = var:bag_wtp_pr23 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:wild_game }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo23 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot23 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor23 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this

		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}

			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm25 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p25 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm25 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr25 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm25 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm25 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng25 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt25 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr25 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo25 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot25 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor25 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest25 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm25 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm25 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng25 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt25 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr25 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p25 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest25
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest25 value = var:bag_wtp_p25 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr25 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest25
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest25 value = var:bag_wtp_pr25 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:wool }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo25 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot25 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor25 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng25 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# beer: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng26` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_26 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p26 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm26 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr26 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm26 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm26 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p26 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm26 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm26 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr26 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm26 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p26 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm26 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr26 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm26 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm26 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p26 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm26 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm26 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr26 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm26 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда

	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.

		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt26 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr26 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo26 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot26 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor26 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest26 value = 0 }

				}

					var:bag_wtp_prm26 > 0

			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm28 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p28 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm28 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr28 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm28 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm28 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm28 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng28 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt28 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr28 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo28 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot28 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor28 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest28 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm28 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm28 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng28 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt28 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr28 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p28 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest28
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest28 value = var:bag_wtp_p28 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr28 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest28
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest28 value = var:bag_wtp_pr28 }
		}
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng28 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# cloth: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng29` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_29 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p29 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm29 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr29 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm29 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm29 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p29 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm29 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm29 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr29 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm29 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p29 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm29 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr29 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm29 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm29 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p29 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm29 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm29 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr29 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm29 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда

	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.

		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr29 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo29 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot29 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor29 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest29 value = 0 }

				}

					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm29 > 0
				}

				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm31 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm31 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr31 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm31 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p31 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm31 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr31 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm31 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm31 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p31 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm31 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm31 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr31 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm31 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng31 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt31 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr31 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo31 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot31 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor31 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest31 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm31 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm31 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng31 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt31 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr31 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p31 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest31
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest31 value = var:bag_wtp_p31 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr31 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest31
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest31 value = var:bag_wtp_pr31 }
		}
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng31 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# furniture: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng32` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_32 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm32 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm32 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm32 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm32 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm32 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng32 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt32 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr32 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo32 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot32 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor32 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest32 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm32 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm32 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng32 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt32 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr32 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,

		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --

		# allocate with.
		if = {

			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest32 value = var:bag_wtp_p32 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {

				var:bag_wtp_pr32 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest32
			}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The

			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm34 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr34 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm34 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm34 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p34 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm34 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm34 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr34 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm34 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng34 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt34 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr34 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo34 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot34 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor34 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest34 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm34 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm34 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng34 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt34 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr34 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p34 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest34
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest34 value = var:bag_wtp_p34 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr34 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest34
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest34 value = var:bag_wtp_pr34 }
		}
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng34 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# lacquerware: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng35` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_35 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p35 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm35 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr35 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm35 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p35 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm35 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm35 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr35 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm35 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p35 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm35 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr35 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm35 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p35 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm35 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm35 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr35 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm35 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng35 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt35 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr35 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo35 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot35 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor35 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest35 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm35 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm35 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng35 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt35 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr35 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,

			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest35 value = var:bag_wtp_p35 }
		}

			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm37 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr37 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm37 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng37 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt37 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr37 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo37 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot37 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor37 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest37 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm37 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm37 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng37 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt37 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr37 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p37 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest37
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest37 value = var:bag_wtp_p37 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr37 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest37
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest37 value = var:bag_wtp_pr37 }
		}
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng37 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# masonry: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng38` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_38 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p38 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm38 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr38 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm38 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm38 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p38 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm38 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm38 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr38 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm38 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p38 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm38 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr38 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm38 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm38 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p38 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm38 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm38 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr38 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm38 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng38 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt38 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr38 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo38 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot38 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor38 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest38 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm38 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm38 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng38 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt38 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr38 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p38 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest38
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest38 value = var:bag_wtp_p38 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr38 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest38
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest38 value = var:bag_wtp_pr38 }
		}
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to

	if = {

	}
}

	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng40 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt40 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr40 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo40 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot40 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor40 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest40 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm40 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm40 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng40 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt40 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr40 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p40 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest40
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest40 value = var:bag_wtp_p40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr40 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest40
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest40 value = var:bag_wtp_pr40 }
		}
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng40 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# porcelain: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng41` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_41 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p41 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr41 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm41 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p41 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm41 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr41 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm41 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm41 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm41 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng41 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt41 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr41 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo41 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot41 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor41 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest41 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm41 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm41 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng41 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt41 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr41 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p41 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest41
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest41 value = var:bag_wtp_p41 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr41 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest41
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest41 value = var:bag_wtp_pr41 }

	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this

		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng43 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt43 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr43 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo43 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot43 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor43 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest43 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm43 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm43 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng43 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt43 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr43 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p43 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest43
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest43 value = var:bag_wtp_p43 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr43 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest43
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest43 value = var:bag_wtp_pr43 }
		}
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng43 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# steel: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng44` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_44 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p44 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm44 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr44 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm44 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm44 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p44 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm44 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm44 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr44 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm44 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p44 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm44 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr44 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm44 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm44 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p44 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm44 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm44 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr44 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm44 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng44 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt44 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr44 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo44 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot44 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor44 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest44 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm44 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm44 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng44 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt44 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr44 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p44 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest44
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest44 value = var:bag_wtp_p44 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr44 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest44
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest44 value = var:bag_wtp_pr44 }
		}
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng44 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}
