	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm46 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm46 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng46 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt46 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr46 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p46 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest46
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest46 value = var:bag_wtp_p46 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr46 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest46
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest46 value = var:bag_wtp_pr46 }
		}
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng46 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# weaponry: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng47` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_47 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p47 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm47 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr47 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm47 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm47 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p47 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm47 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm47 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr47 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm47 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p47 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm47 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr47 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm47 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm47 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p47 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm47 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm47 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr47 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm47 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng47 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt47 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr47 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo47 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot47 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor47 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest47 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm47 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm47 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng47 add = 1 }
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt47 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr47 add = 1 }
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p47 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest47
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest47 value = var:bag_wtp_p47 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr47 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest47
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest47 value = var:bag_wtp_pr47 }
		}
	}

	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng47 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# One good, into the location in hand.
#
# **Guarded, and asked the same question the ordered walk used as its `limit`**,
# so the urban-rights round can call this on its own without repeating a word --
# and so a right whose second good wants a building the first took is simply not
# given it.
#
# The building goes into a list beside the good, because that is what a location
# can only hold one of. Which building it is comes off the method the harvest
# kept.
# clay, town side.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_plan_try_town_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_can_town_1 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 39
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 39 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout1 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:clay_pit }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn1 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt1 add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p1` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p1 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# clay, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_town_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_1 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'
			# `EDIT walk` line says which of the two failed.
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 39
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 39 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout1 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:clay_pit }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn1 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt1 add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p1` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p1 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# dyes, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_town_4 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_4 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'

			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm7 = 110 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout7 add = 30 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fruit }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn7 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt7 add = 1 }

			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p7` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.

bag_wtp_edit_place_town_7 = {

			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_7 = yes

			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'

		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm7 = 110
			} }

			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p7` is the

# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_town_13 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_13 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'
			# `EDIT walk` line says which of the two failed.
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm13 = 172
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm13 = 172 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout13 add = 60 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:lumber }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:shoen }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn13 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt13 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_bn4 add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p13` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p13 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p13 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# sand, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_town_17 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_17 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'
			# `EDIT walk` line says which of the two failed.
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm17 = 204
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm17 = 204 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout17 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:sand }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt17 add = 1 }

			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 210 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout20 add = 50 } }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 211 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout20 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:stone }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:stone_quarry }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn20 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt20 add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p20` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p20 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p20 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#

# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_21 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'
			# `EDIT walk` line says which of the two failed.
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm21 = 212
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm21 = 212 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout21 add = 100 } }

# beer, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

bag_wtp_edit_place_town_26 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_26 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds

			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'

# cannons, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

# cloth, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

# fine_cloth, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

# firearms, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

# glass, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_33 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds

# lacquerware, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_town_35 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_35 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'
			# `EDIT walk` line says which of the two failed.
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 140
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 140 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout35 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:lacquerware }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:lacquerware_guild }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn35 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt35 add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p35` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p35 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p35 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 141
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm35 = 141 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout35 add = 200 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:lacquerware }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:lacquerware_manufactory }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn35 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt35 add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question

# liquor, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

# masonry, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_town_38 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_38 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'
			# `EDIT walk` line says which of the two failed.
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm38 = 173

			} }

			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p38` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.

				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p38 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {

			} }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt38 add = 1 }

# paper, town side, **for the editor**.

# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a

				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p42 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {

				var:bag_wtp_pm42 = 198
			} }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn42 add = 1 }

# pottery, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_town_42 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_42 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'
			# `EDIT walk` line says which of the two failed.

		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm42 = 195
			} }

			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:pottery_guild }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }

# tools, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_town_46 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_46 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'

# weaponry, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a

# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_3 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'
			# `EDIT walk` line says which of the two failed.
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_rural
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_prm3 = 57
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm3 = 57 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout3 add = 100 } }

# lumber, village side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_rural_13 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_13 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'
			# `EDIT walk` line says which of the two failed.
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_rural
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_prm13 = 172
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm13 = 172 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout13 add = 60 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:lumber }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:shoen }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn13 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnr13 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_bn4 add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_pr13` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_pr13 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pr13 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_pr21` is the

# sugar, village side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_rural_21 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_21 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'
			# `EDIT walk` line says which of the two failed.
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_rural
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_prm21 = 212
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm21 = 212 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout21 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:sugar }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:sugar_plantation }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn21 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnr21 add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_pr21` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_pr21 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pr21 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnr38 add = 1 }

			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них

			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.

				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {

			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm38 = 175 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout38 add = 80 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:masonry }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:shoen }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn38 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnr38 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_bn4 add = 1 }

# masonry, village side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

bag_wtp_edit_place_rural_38 = {

		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_38 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'

			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_pr43` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per

# tar, village side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_rural_45 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_45 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'
			# `EDIT walk` line says which of the two failed.
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_rural
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_prm45 = 213
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm45 = 213 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout45 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tar }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:tar_kiln }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn45 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnr45 add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_pr45` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_pr45 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pr45 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

			# `EDIT walk` line says which of the two failed.
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_rural

			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per

# Urban rights, before any good is placed and only in towns.
#
# **A right is a bundle of goods bound to a town, and obeys the rules a good
# obeys.** The owner, 2026-09-03: «права это просто связка товара, которая
# заложена в город. В остальном она подчиняется абсолютно тем же вещам что и
# простой товар.» So it is dealt exactly as a good is: **a quota over the whole
# ground says how many towns a right may take, and descending bands of gain say
# which towns those are.**
#
# **The quota is the "равномерно" half and it is the only limit.** Neither
# divisor this ever carried survives: the map-wide one made the ranges disjoint,
# so a right granted once could never again win on merit and they went round
# robin; the province-wide one emptied a province of the charter its ground was
# made for. The quota limits the count and leaves the placement to the ground,
# which is the whole distinction the owner drew.
#
# **The bands are what put a scarce charter where it belongs.** A town takes a
# right only where the ground pays at least the band, so the two towns on the map
# with silver under them are reached by the jewelry charter in band 800, before
# any town is handed a charter it merely tolerates. The last pass lifts the quota
# and the band together, so no town is left without one.
#
# **And a right is granted whether or not the whole bundle fits**, since
# 2026-09-01: «Оно БУДЕТ выдано ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО. И каждый такой город обязательно
# получит все здания из его бонуса.» The bundle's buildings go in before any
# ordinary good touches the town, and where the urban cap is smaller than the
# bundle the town simply runs out of room.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_place_rights = {
	# How many rights this country could grant at all. The quota is towns divided
	# by that, so a country with three rights available spreads over three and not
	# over the 13 the game defines.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_1 = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_2 = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_3 = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_4 = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_5 = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_6 = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_7 = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_8 = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_9 = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_10 = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_11 = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_12 = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_13 = yes }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rgrant add = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rquota value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_towns }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rgrant > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rquota divide = bag_wtp_rgrant_value }
	}
	# `max` is the floor on a variable operation -- `_plan_quota` above depends on
	# the same and says so. A ground with fewer towns than rights still gives every
	# charter one town to want.
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rquota max = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn2 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn4 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn5 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn6 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn7 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn8 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn9 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn10 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn11 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn12 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rn13 value = 0 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rlevel value = 0 }
	while = {
		limit = {
			global_var:bag_wtp_rlevel < global_var:bag_wtp_rquota
			global_var:bag_wtp_rlevel < 12
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rlevel add = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rband value = 800 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ropen value = 0 }
		bag_wtp_plan_grant_pass = yes
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rband value = 600 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ropen value = 0 }
		bag_wtp_plan_grant_pass = yes
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rband value = 400 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ropen value = 0 }
		bag_wtp_plan_grant_pass = yes
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rband value = 200 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ropen value = 0 }
		bag_wtp_plan_grant_pass = yes
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rband value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ropen value = 0 }
		bag_wtp_plan_grant_pass = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_rlevel < global_var:bag_wtp_rquota }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rlevel value = global_var:bag_wtp_rquota }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rband value = 800 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ropen value = 0 }
			bag_wtp_plan_grant_pass = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rband value = 600 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ropen value = 0 }
			bag_wtp_plan_grant_pass = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rband value = 400 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ropen value = 0 }
			bag_wtp_plan_grant_pass = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rband value = 200 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ropen value = 0 }
			bag_wtp_plan_grant_pass = yes
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rband value = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ropen value = 0 }
			bag_wtp_plan_grant_pass = yes
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rband value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ropen value = 1 }
	bag_wtp_plan_grant_pass = yes
}

# One pass of the rights round: every town still empty takes the best right the
# ground pays `_rband` for and whose quota is not spent.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_grant_pass = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
			var:bag_wtp_load = 0
		}
		# **Minus one and not nought.** The winner is taken with `rtry > rbest`, so
		# a charter this ground pays exactly nothing for could never win even when it
		# was the only one left: 2026-09-03, Westphalia has no precious metal at all,
		# the jewelry charter scored 0 in all 48 towns, and even the covering ladder
		# could not place it. `_rbest_k` still starts at 0, so a town where no charter
		# fits gets none.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 0 }
		# constantinopolitan_silk_monopoly_rights: cloth, fine_cloth, silk
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_1 = yes
				# The band: what this ground has to pay before the charter is taken
				# here at all. The open pass sets it to 0.
				var:bag_wtp_rtry >= global_var:bag_wtp_rband
				# The level: how many towns any one charter may hold so far. It
				# climbs by one at a time, so no charter takes an Nth town while
				# another is still short of its Nth -- that, and not the quota it
				# ends at, is what makes the counts come out level. The open pass
				# lifts it: a town with no charter at all is worse than an uneven count.
				OR = {
					global_var:bag_wtp_ropen = 1
					global_var:bag_wtp_rn1 < global_var:bag_wtp_rlevel
				}
				scope:bag_wtp_country = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_1 = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 1 }
		}
		# flemish_cloth_industries_right: cloth, fine_cloth
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rtry value = bag_wtp_rq2 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:bag_wtp_rtry > var:bag_wtp_rbest
				bag_wtp_plan_right_fits_2 = yes
				# The band: what this ground has to pay before the charter is taken
				# here at all. The open pass sets it to 0.
				var:bag_wtp_rtry >= global_var:bag_wtp_rband
				# The level: how many towns any one charter may hold so far. It
				# climbs by one at a time, so no charter takes an Nth town while
				# another is still short of its Nth -- that, and not the quota it
				# ends at, is what makes the counts come out level. The open pass
				# lifts it: a town with no charter at all is worse than an uneven count.
				OR = {
					global_var:bag_wtp_ropen = 1
					global_var:bag_wtp_rn2 < global_var:bag_wtp_rlevel
				}
				scope:bag_wtp_country = { bag_wtp_plan_right_gate_2 = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest value = var:bag_wtp_rtry }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rbest_k value = 2 }
		}

# How many buildings each good may claim before the ground is opened to all.
#
# **Две дележки, по одной на сторону.** Городские комнаты делятся между
# товарами, которые умеют встать в городе; сельские — между умеющими в селе.
# Товар, умеющий обе стороны, держит обе квоты и тратит их порознь.
#
# **Это заменило трёхклассовую долю, и та была костылём.** Классы «только
# город» / «только село» / «где угодно» понадобились ровно потому, что квота
# была одна на обе стороны; с двумя квотами класс товара перестаёт что-либо
# значить — он просто участвует в тех дележках, где может.
#
# **`max = 1` — пол, и он намеренный.** Земля, которой мало на всех, всё равно
# даёт каждому по домику; уступает лимит, а не разброс. Скидка за РГО
# вычитается из квоты той стороны, где эти РГО лежат.
# **И потолок каждого здания, за которое спорят несколько товаров.** Он равен
# общей доле и растёт вместе с ней: сухой круг поднимает и квоты товаров, и эти.
# Без него торговая деревня -- один слот на пять товаров -- встаёт впятеро чаще
# любого однотоварного домика, и на северной Германии встала 225 раз против 61 у
# всех остальных. Его слова, 2026-09-07: «я хочу, чтобы лесных деревень тоже было
# 60, как и каких-нибудь сельских суконщиков».

# The draft: a level a lap, and no good takes its second before every good that
# can has taken its first.
#
# **Coverage is lap one.** At `_plan_lvl = 1` the level gate is `_pn<n> = 0`,
# which is exactly what the covering pass used to test, and lap one runs every
# band down to 0 -- so a good the ground feeds nothing still takes a place.
#
# **The open ladder is a dry lap.** When a whole lap places nothing, every quota
# rises by one and the next lap tries again: the rooms left over after the share
# is spent are dealt in level layers like everything else. Two dry laps running
# mean the ground is full rather than the quota, and the draft stops.
#
# **`_plan_top` is why a dry lap does not stop the extension dead.** «Расширить»
# runs this over a plan that already stands, where every good holds several
# buildings, so the first laps cannot place anything at all -- the level has to
# climb past what is already there first. A lap only counts as dry once the level
# is above every count the draft started with.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_allocate = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_lvl value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_laps value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_dry value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_top value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_go value = 1 }
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_pxt1

		if = { limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_laps = 40 } set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn40 value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_added } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_added = 0
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_lvl > global_var:bag_wtp_plan_top
			}
			# **Сухой круг открывает квоту, и это вся бывшая открытая лестница.**
			# Поднимаются все квоты разом, поэтому остаток земли расходится теми же
			# ровными слоями, что и доля. `_plan_opensw` -- сколько раз подняли.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_dry add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_opensw add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pq1 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pqt1 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pqr1 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pq2 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pqt2 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pqr2 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pq3 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pqt3 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pqr3 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pq4 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pqt4 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pqr4 add = 1 }

# clay takes the one location each side of it suits best, or neither.
#
# `max = 1` on an ordered walk is the engine doing the choosing, which is the
# only reason a lap over 47 goods twice is affordable. The tier gate above the
# walk holds a common good back while a scarce one is still picking; the level
# gate holds every good to one building a lap.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_pick_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			# **Ступень считает места этой стороны, а не обе разом.** Всё
			# остальное в раздаче стороны различает -- два счётчика, две квоты,
			# два потолка, -- и одни только ворота ступени складывали их в одно
			# число. Северная Германия, 2026-09-07, показала, чего это стоит:
			# `naval_supplies` умеет 178 локаций всего, но в сёлах только 42 --
			# ровно столько же, сколько рыба, -- и по общему числу проходил как
			# массовый товар, то есть выбирал побережье последним, наравне с
			# теми, кому подходят все 416.
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier = 0
				AND = {
					global_var:bag_wtp_ngt1 > 0
					global_var:bag_wtp_ngt1 <= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier
				}
			}
			# **Уровень: один домик за круг, и это вся равномерность.**
			# Никакой товар не берёт второй, пока каждый, кто может, не взял
			# первый. Полоса выгоды решает, в какую локацию и кто раньше внутри
			# круга, -- но «сколько» она больше не решает, и восемь товаров с
			# шестью местами каждый, кончивших план с одним домиком, -- это она.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_lvl
			# **Квота своей стороны, и она про сторону, а не про равномерность.**
			# Городская комната и сельская не взаимозаменяемы, поэтому у товара
			# два счётчика: городские домики сравниваются с городскими остальных,
			# сельские — с сельскими. Один общий счётчик прятал ровно то, что
			# владелец увидел: «15 стекла» из 13 сельских и 2 городских выглядели
			# равными «15 текстиля» из 15 городских, а это разные планы.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 < global_var:bag_wtp_pq1
			global_var:bag_wtp_pnt1 < global_var:bag_wtp_pqt1
			# **Замороженный товар не берёт ничего, и квота его не спасёт.**
			# «Расширить» ставит `_frz<n>` на закреплённые и на «не нужен»: их
			# квота приравнена к тому, что у них есть, но сухой круг поднимает
			# всякую квоту на единицу, и одного равенства хватило бы ровно на
			# один круг. **Свежий план сюда не попадает**: `_frz<n>` ставит
			# только доливка и снимает сама, а `_plan_prepare` снимает ещё раз --
			# функция 3 не читает состояние редактора.
			NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_frz1 }
			# **Товар, которому места кончились, больше не ходит по земле.**
			# Обход по кандидатам -- единственное, что в раздаче стоит дорого, и
			# круг за кругом его повторял товар, у которого свободной подходящей
			# локации нет вовсе. Флаг ставится ниже, перед обходом на полосе 0,
			# и снимается самим обходом, если тот что-то нашёл: на полосе 0 порог
			# не отсекает ничего, поэтому «не нашёл» там значит именно «мест
			# нет», а комнаты по ходу плана только убывают.
			NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_pxt1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pxt1 value = 1 }
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# **The threshold, and it is the whole of the optimum.** The ground
			# is dealt in descending order of gain across every good at once, so
			# by the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the
			# good that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is
			# the opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by
			# asking every other good what it would have made of the place.
			#
			# **`_plan_band` itself, and no longer a threshold per good.** There
			# were two: the band for the fair share and each good's own best for
			# the open ladder, because on a realm-sized ground the quota never
			# bound and the band became the whole allocator. The level binds
			# instead now, on every ground and from the first lap, so the second
			# threshold has nothing left to fix -- and a good whose best pays 300
			# simply places at band 200 of the same lap.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_town_1 = yes
				bag_wtp_ord1 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ord1
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_pxt1
			bag_wtp_plan_try_town_1 = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			# **Ступень считает места этой стороны, а не обе разом.** Всё
			# остальное в раздаче стороны различает -- два счётчика, две квоты,
			# два потолка, -- и одни только ворота ступени складывали их в одно
			# число. Северная Германия, 2026-09-07, показала, чего это стоит:
			# `naval_supplies` умеет 178 локаций всего, но в сёлах только 42 --
			# ровно столько же, сколько рыба, -- и по общему числу проходил как
			# массовый товар, то есть выбирал побережье последним, наравне с
			# теми, кому подходят все 416.
			OR = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier = 0
				AND = {
					global_var:bag_wtp_ngr1 > 0
					global_var:bag_wtp_ngr1 <= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_tier
				}
			}
			# **Уровень: один домик за круг, и это вся равномерность.**
			# Никакой товар не берёт второй, пока каждый, кто может, не взял
			# первый. Полоса выгоды решает, в какую локацию и кто раньше внутри
			# круга, -- но «сколько» она больше не решает, и восемь товаров с
			# шестью местами каждый, кончивших план с одним домиком, -- это она.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_lvl
			# **Квота своей стороны, и она про сторону, а не про равномерность.**
			# Городская комната и сельская не взаимозаменяемы, поэтому у товара
			# два счётчика: городские домики сравниваются с городскими остальных,
			# сельские — с сельскими. Один общий счётчик прятал ровно то, что
			# владелец увидел: «15 стекла» из 13 сельских и 2 городских выглядели
			# равными «15 текстиля» из 15 городских, а это разные планы.
			global_var:bag_wtp_pn1 < global_var:bag_wtp_pq1
			global_var:bag_wtp_pnr1 < global_var:bag_wtp_pqr1
			# **Замороженный товар не берёт ничего, и квота его не спасёт.**
			# «Расширить» ставит `_frz<n>` на закреплённые и на «не нужен»: их
			# квота приравнена к тому, что у них есть, но сухой круг поднимает
			# всякую квоту на единицу, и одного равенства хватило бы ровно на
			# один круг. **Свежий план сюда не попадает**: `_frz<n>` ставит
			# только доливка и снимает сама, а `_plan_prepare` снимает ещё раз --
			# функция 3 не читает состояние редактора.
			NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_frz1 }
			# **Товар, которому места кончились, больше не ходит по земле.**
			# Обход по кандидатам -- единственное, что в раздаче стоит дорого, и
			# круг за кругом его повторял товар, у которого свободной подходящей
			# локации нет вовсе. Флаг ставится ниже, перед обходом на полосе 0,
			# и снимается самим обходом, если тот что-то нашёл: на полосе 0 порог
			# не отсекает ничего, поэтому «не нашёл» там значит именно «мест
			# нет», а комнаты по ходу плана только убывают.
			NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_pxr1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band = 0 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pxr1 value = 1 }
		}
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_candidates
			# **The threshold, and it is the whole of the optimum.** The ground
			# is dealt in descending order of gain across every good at once, so
			# by the time a good that would gain a tenth reaches a location, the
			# good that would have gained nine tenths has already taken it. That is
			# the opportunity cost, paid for by one comparison rather than by
			# asking every other good what it would have made of the place.
			#
			# **`_plan_band` itself, and no longer a threshold per good.** There
			# were two: the band for the fair share and each good's own best for
			# the open ladder, because on a realm-sized ground the quota never
			# bound and the band became the whole allocator. The level binds
			# instead now, on every ground and from the first lap, so the second
			# threshold has nothing left to fix -- and a good whose best pays 300
			# simply places at band 200 of the same lap.
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_can_rural_1 = yes
				bag_wtp_ordr1 >= global_var:bag_wtp_plan_band
			}
			order_by = bag_wtp_ordr1
			max = 1
			check_range_bounds = no
			remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_pxr1
			bag_wtp_plan_try_rural_1 = yes
		}
	}
}
